timing: recorded after two infrastructure-only failed launches and before any benchmark score, completed pose, sensitivity result, or enrichment metric existed
trigger: two pre-result Windows launches exposed external-tool path transport defects: legacy-length source paths, followed by staged ligand and output paths interpreted relative to Vina's worker directory

aborted_local_attempts.cause: the external executable rejected long absolute source paths before docking
the staged ligand and output paths were relative and were reinterpreted beneath Vina's worker directory

changes.execution_input_transport: copy each already hash-verified receptor and ligand PDBQT byte-for-byte into a bounded short path beneath the create-only run root before invoking Vina
changes.staging_verification: require source and staged byte count and SHA-256 to match before execution
changes.absolute_external_tool_paths: resolve every staged input, output, stdout, and stderr path absolutely before entering the worker directory or invoking Vina
changes.path_preflight: reject an overlong external-tool path before the first entry attempt starts
changes.retry_policy: both aborted local roots are retained as technical evidence and are never resumed or published; the corrected execution uses a new create-only root

invariants.vina_executable_and_arguments: unchanged except for byte-identical staged inputs, absolute bounded transport paths, and a new output root
